high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a LinkedIn post discussing the hypothetical scenario of whether the Avada Kedavra curse would work on Hagrid from the Harry Potter series. The post is authored by Gordon Alexander Fallon, who works as a Restaurant and Banquet Manager at Hospitality Management (2019–present). The post was updated 3 years ago. The text in the post explains that Hagrid, being half giant, has a level of immunity or tolerance to spells due to his mixed heritage.
